conclusion: The proposal accurately identifies a substantive production custody/type gap and covers the required initial/retained preparation, journals, Artifact, FinalUse, CAS, live checks and cold recovery. No specific false completion or authority claim was found. Existing APIs alone cannot construct the proposed cross-UID PublishedTask/Version path; this review is not implementation or launch approval.

sources.detail: Open requires actual euid 0, an absolute pre-existing Root-owned private directory and validated ancestors; private objects remain uid 0 / 0600 / single-link / NOFOLLOW.
Production storage is concrete HostAuthorityFrontierStore. The arbitrary AuthorityFrontierStore variant is cfg(test) only. A remote receipt or fixture FileCas cannot supply this owner.

Validate selected full target, empty file and independent empty witness; revalidate Artifact; persist Preparing; open the actual header-only guarded journal; retain journal and selection through publish.

Check external FinalUse frontier and exact selection; claim and dispatch the exact independent grant; revalidate Artifact and actual genesis inside the dispatch; CAS and exact original-operation readback. No transient unsigned Active owner.

original_chain.stage: Retained A-to-C binding and cold preparation

sources.detail: Full completed A binding/history/run/agent/cell/principal/manifest/checkpoint and distinct C source/task are checked before mutation, not only a digest or drained flag.

Actual same T/E reads bracket preparation and publication; D is retained in the authenticated context/Version cut. Context freshness, cancellation and exact operation remain; publication returns those same T/E clients.

Require an existing nonempty original predecessor and real durable drain; reopen under the concrete Control floor. Same-model retirement does not manufacture STOP and does not return an active old runtime.

original_chain.stage: Journal lock coverage, Artifact and CAS

sources.detail: Retain old/new exclusive journals. Validate reset; privately rebind old to concrete Control before locking Artifact to avoid a nested live-guard lock cycle. Keep Artifact through prepare/genesis; keep predecessor lock through actual CAS/readback, then drop old.
Exact old owner observation/checkpoint, durable drain, same scope, new task/run and generation/writer_epoch increments, exact selection and same-model mode enter the durable intent.

Inside actual FinalUse claim/dispatch, revalidate selected Artifact, exact old and new checkpoints and current prepared head, then original protected CAS and readback. Remote before/after booleans cannot replace this critical section.
Actual immutable registry/payload bytes, canonical full manifest, independent selection verifier, concrete Artifact CURRENT and fixed withdrawal cut remain required.

original_chain.stage: Live authority retained by published task

sources.detail: The concrete guard retains Current, Artifact, selected payload, independent FinalUse authority, original signed grant and consumed witness. Each check is Current -> Artifact/selected/retained FinalUse -> Current; lock order is Artifact -> selected -> FinalUse.
Ready owns journal plus concrete Arc<LiveGenerationCurrent>; it rebinds the real journal before consuming it into the task.
The update Ready owner likewise retains concrete live custody and consumes the original previous completion; no public remote-current adapter or journal getter exists.

Private PublishedTask fixes Mutex<Box<dyn OriginalVersion>> and Arc<LiveGenerationCurrent>. Clone retains the same task Arc/journal. Public Cell open uses that same task; arbitrary guard input is unavailable.
Actual Source must match original input/bundle/receipt, no pending inference, revision 1 and exact checkpoint/writer_epoch; current is checked before and after.

Requires Arc::ptr_eq(task, cell.task), Source read before and after committed lookup and after durable drain, actual journal drain/readback, then current again. An encoded completion or cloned file cannot meet this constructor boundary.
Original admission, actual execution and readback are gated by the same task and current checks; a remote task bridge must preserve those call sites, including the guarded native entry clock.

Actual original_a Source is read repeatedly around completion validation and C factory creation; the original same-model publication/task/full cut enters with_q24_circuit_task_profile. Installed Cell/Source and original C config are concrete values, not a version receipt.

Fresh one-use atomics and phase.take fence effects. Failure/cancellation does not refill phase. After actual publication and install, original config is consumed once into crate::run; signed C ingress/RunStart remains separate.

Version still holds concrete control and concrete Artifact state. Fresh requires actual completed A before construction; cold consumes already-held actual C Cell/Source and cannot gain an issuer/fresh config.
D/T/E are re-read around phase observation, Artifact before/after is compared, Prepared state uses exact Current recover/read, and a published Current record alone does not recreate C owner/factory.

Uses the real Artifact owner, checkpoint, signed selection/verifier and unchanged withdrawal scope/head. Checkpoint/current receipt/witness/trust and non-regressing observation time are compared. A copied registry cannot replace it.
Exact operation/intent and actual Published state only; existing nonempty target, Artifact/FinalUse/live checks, original journal reopen and a second Current read. Prepared is no redispatch.
Same exact operation/intent; Prepared refuses; actual Published target is opened without fresh genesis/reset and confirmed by a second Current observation.

Historical completion reconstruction requires an already-published, live successor, real acknowledged predecessor Cell/Source history and no writer. It cannot bootstrap the first retained C publication.
Original evaluated T/E readback and full context remain around same-operation recovery and the original historical predecessor reconstruction; no new grant/prepare.

practical_boundary.can_implement_without_relaxing_existing_: A trusted-Root-local one-operation coordinator can own genuine pre-held Root directory/Current, original selected Artifact, actual FinalUse authority and original journal/witnesses; its internal state holds the existing non-Clone Prepared and Ready values. This can reuse original prepare/publish/recovery APIs unchanged.
practical_boundary.not_established: No production producer or authenticated peer-facing session implementation is supplied by the proposal. It is not permission to initialize an arbitrary caller-selected Current head or trust.

practical_boundary.required_new_sealed_interface: If A/C tasks remain non-Root, Ready/PublishedTask/live-guard custody needs a concrete purpose-bound producer/receiver and an internal fixed representation that preserves every live check. Existing Arc<LiveGenerationCurrent> signatures cannot accept a remote check_current client.
practical_boundary.not_allowed: No externally implemented generic guard, callback, raw Current store or borrowed root directory getter; no constant/cached success token. A process cannot serialize an Arc and thereby preserve original owner identity.

practical_boundary.required_new_sealed_interface: Retirement must occur in the process that actually retains the same task Arc and Cell together with the original Source readback, or all those actual owners must be deliberately co-located under a separately reviewed topology. A handoff must prove that actual result and exclusive journal/witness custody to the Root coordinator.
practical_boundary.not_allowed: No public constructor for completion from JSON/digests; no re-opened Source/ledger writer pretending to be the original. Existing recover_predecessor depends on Published C, so it is circular as a source of the completion required before first C prepare.

practical_boundary.required_new_sealed_interface: Keeping Version non-Root also requires exact local-vs-remote internal custody for Prepared operation readback, Artifact/withdrawal observations, original_a Source checks, and installed C task/Cell/Source. All are concrete in the current host/state/c_task signatures.
practical_boundary.not_allowed: Adding one remote Current query or a C publication response does not satisfy Version construction/install. Keep original same-Arc T/E sharing, original phase consumption and full freshness checks; do not add another T connection.

practical_boundary.implementation_precondition: New transport framing, peer identity, actual UID/pidfd/boot/start, operation binding, end and per-message limits must be explicitly reviewed. Original Current/Artifact critical sections are synchronous; do not release their original lock coverage around a remote await and call it the same CAS guarantee.
practical_boundary.not_allowed: No permission or timeout/4-permit/request-budget increase is approved here; no same-UID Root loopback exemption to f42. Whole-task relocation to Root is a topology change, not an already-available shortcut.

clarifications.detail: PublishedCircuitFeatureTaskV1 and PublishedCircuitFeatureCompletionV1 are Clone. The first retains the same task Arc; the second is a historical fact with no fresh authority. Do not misdescribe all values as non-Clone or require a new Arc strong-count rule. The concrete preparation and C config are the consumed one-operation custody.

Original code has prepare_forward_recovery and prepare_initial_forward_recovery. They require a different operation ID, the same actual prepared journals/genesis, and a new independent signature; no nonce refund. A minimal readback-only/lost-ACK service can deliberately exclude them, but should not claim the source has no such operator operation or silently auto-invoke them.

Raw NeuronGenerationCurrentOwnerV1::initialize is trusted Root setup, not a substitute for the full first-A prepare_initial/FinalUse path. Do not expose arbitrary initialize/replacement heads through the proposed service.

FinalUse consumer nonce-store euid and UID-0 Host issuer remain separate. Moving the coordinator does not authorize reopening a UID-60001 consumer store as UID 0 or fabricating a new authority from an issuer response.

The proposal correctly remains design-only. The material-only split and B objective separation may proceed as test-only mechanisms, but neither solves production Root Current/CAS custody or proves a real three-UID task.

remaining_gaps: No implemented actual same-owner retirement handoff accepted by Root
No remote Version control+Artifact+OriginalA observation integration
No actual C factory/config/daemon and separate signed ingress completion across this topology
No fixed implementation-level wire/frame/deadline contract or runtime qualification for these proposed new services
